significance: A Shiva temple at Tindivanam whose linga is worshipped as Thinthirineesvarar and whose goddess is Maragathavalli or Marathambal; it also goes by the names Thindeechuram, Thinthiruni and Pulithinthirunvanam. It is counted among the Vaippu Sthalams named in the hymns of the Nayanar Appar.
story: The temple's vimana is said to have been raised by Vyasa, and the deity to have been worshipped by Valmiki and Vyasa among others.
